body: Market appears to price an inland up-cycle plus a data-center power-gen growth story at 17x forward EPS / 9.5x EV/EBITDA. Our view: no claimable mispricing; on reported FCF the price is roughly fair (~3.8% perpetual growth at 9.5% CoE), on NOPAT with honest reinvestment it is rich. Evidence: ROTC 10.4% (2023-25), escalators decelerating, term renewals flat-to-low-single-digit 2025-26, fuel lag, Jones Act waiver, receivables build, insider selling. Proves us wrong: FY26 EPS >= 7.28, 2027 renewals high-single digits, power-gen growth > 20%. Scored by thesis:paper-call:US-KEX:*.
